## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem This Solves

Describe the problem or limitation this feature would address.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like this feature to work.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Use Case

Provide a concrete example of how this feature would be used.

```bash
# Example command or Python code
onyx task "your example task"
```

## Scope

- [ ] CLI command
- [ ] Python library API
- [ ] REST API endpoint
- [ ] Web dashboard
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Would You Like to Implement This?

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a pull request
- [ ] No, just suggesting the idea
- [ ] Maybe, with some guidance
